full_name: Fei-Hsien Wang | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 History Hilles Bush Fellow Indiana University
bio: Fei-Hsien Wang is a historian of modern China, particularly interested in how information, ideas, and practices were produced, transmitted, and consumed across different East Asian societies.
